objective: Verify supplied candidate pairs and recorded computational evidence; report successful declared technical gates with properties and candidate-specific flags.

inputs.output_directory: Choose a NEW external run directory or a new results subdirectory; existing destinations are refused.

execution: Portable deterministic evidence review; no model/backend dispatch
example_evidence: Actual recorded KRAS14 assessment; source job and earlier-job identities plus input hashes are bound by the bundle.
prohibited: turning missing native experimental/translational evidence into a scientific pass
claiming source checkpoints or a copied result are a new backend execution
treating repeated predictions as independent measured validation
scope_note: Technical validation covers declared computational checks; biological efficacy, safety and delivery are separate evaluation stages.
